summary: Taiwan Cement Corporation, operating as TCC Group Holdings Co Ltd., is a diverse Taiwanese conglomerate established in 1946 and based in Taipei. Its primary business involves the manufacturing and distribution of cement, associated products, and ready-mix concrete within Taiwan, alongside international exports of cement and cement clinkers. TCC also plays a role in the energy sector, producing thermal and renewable power.

name: Chia Hsin Cement Corp
summary: Chia Hsin Cement Corporation primarily specializes in the manufacturing and global sales of cement, serving both the Taiwanese domestic market and international clients. The company's broad operational scope extends to building materials distribution, non-metallic minerals extraction, mixed concrete production, and real estate development, construction, and leasing. Founded in 1954, Chia Hsin Cement Corporation is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Universal Cement Corp
summary: Headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, Universal Cement Corporation, established in 1959, focuses primarily on the manufacturing and distribution of construction materials within Taiwan, such as cement, ready-mixed concrete, and gypsum board panels. The company also extends into the high-tech sector by offering advanced pressure-sensing electronic devices.

name: Great Wall Enterprise Co Ltd
summary: Great Wall Enterprise Co., Ltd. engages in agricultural and animal products business in Taiwan, China, Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Cambodia, including edible oil manufacturing, food dealership, grain milling, feed and fertilizer manufacturing, livestock farming, and related retail, hospitality and real estate businesses. Founded in 1957, the company is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Uni-President Enterprises Corp
summary: Uni-President Enterprises Corp. is a broad-based conglomerate primarily focused on the production, processing, and distribution of a wide array of consumer goods across Taiwan, China, and international markets, encompassing foodstuffs, beverages, animal feed and flour, plus diversified ventures in retail, entertainment, and real estate. Established in 1967, the company is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: AGV Products Corp
summary: AGV Products Corporation engages in the manufacturing, processing, and sale of beverages and canned goods in Taiwan and Mainland China, offering fruit juices, dairy products, refrigerated goods, and health products. The company was founded in 1971 and is based in Chiayi Hsien, Taiwan.

name: Lian HWA Food Corp
summary: Lian Hwa Foods Corporation, a Taiwanese company, is involved in production, processing, and distribution across the food industry, offering seaweed, squid, pasta, snacks, and confectioneries under brands including KOLOKO and Lucky Star. Established in 1960, it is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: USI Corp
summary: USI Corporation operates as a globally active enterprise involved in the creation, production, and sale of a diverse spectrum of chemical and plastic items, centering on polyethylene resins, vinyl chloride monomer, PVC powder, and specialized materials. Originally incorporated in 1965 as USI Far East Corporation, the company is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: China General Plastics Corp
summary: China General Plastics Corporation is a global manufacturer, distributor, and service provider specializing in vinyl products including PVC resins and compounds, PVC pipes and fittings, films and sheets, and synthetic leather. Established in 1964, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Asia Polymer Corp
summary: Asia Polymer Corporation is a Taiwan-based company specializing in the design, development, manufacturing, and global distribution of low-density polyethylene (LDPE) and ethylene vinyl acetate copolymer (EVA), along with related petrochemical products. Established in 1977, the company is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, and operates as a subsidiary of USI Corporation.

name: Tong Yang Industry Co Ltd
summary: Tong Yang Industry Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of parts, components, and models for automobiles in Taiwan, China, the United States, and internationally, including plastics and sheet metal products, tooling molds, and pollution prevention equipment. The company was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Tung Ho Steel Enterprise Corp
summary: Based in Taipei, Taiwan, Tung Ho Textile Co., Ltd. operates as a key supplier of textile products within the country, offering natural, polyester, lyocell, viscose, and acrylic/acrylate fibers as well as specialized functional yarns. Established in 1953.

name: Tama Home Co Ltd
summary: Founded in 1998 and based in Tokyo, Japan, Tama Home Co., Ltd. operates across construction, property development, architectural solutions, and insurance brokerage, delivering personalized residential construction, real estate sales, insurance intermediation, and solar power management.

name: Fortune Electric Co Ltd
summary: Fortune Electric Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese firm that specializes in the production, processing, and commercialization of electrical power equipment, including power transformers, switchboards, switchgear, and substation components. Established in 1969, the company is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: TYC Brother Industrial Co Ltd
summary: TYC Brother Industrial Co., Ltd. focuses on the production and distribution of automotive lighting solutions throughout Taiwan, along with other car components including mirrors, cooling fans, radiators, and condensers. Established in 1986, the company is headquartered in Tainan, Taiwan.

name: China Metal Products
summary: China Metal Products Co., Ltd., established in 1972 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, is a diversified conglomerate spanning metal manufacturing (iron casting components for vehicles and machinery), real estate development, and lifestyle hospitality including hotels and amusement parks.

name: Ta Ya Electric Wire & Cable
summary: Ta Ya Electric Wire & Cable Co., Ltd. specializes in the production and distribution of a comprehensive range of electrical wires and cables, serving Taiwan and other Asian regions, including cables for household electronics, power grids, fire safety systems, and infrastructure. Established in Tainan City, Taiwan, in 1955.

name: K&O Energy Group Inc
summary: K&O Energy Group Inc. focuses on the natural gas industry, engaging in its exploration, extraction, distribution, and sale across Japan and internationally, and also manufactures iodine and supplies city gas and LP gas. Founded in 2014, the company is headquartered in Mobara, Japan.

name: Ryoyo Ryosan Holdings Inc
summary: Ryoyo Ryosan Holdings, Inc., founded in 2024 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, operates as a distributor of technological and electronic products, including semiconductors, information technology goods, and electronic parts within the Japanese market.

name: China Man-Made Fiber Corp
summary: Established in 1955 and based in Taipei, Taiwan, China Man-Made Fiber Corporation focuses on the production and distribution of man-made fibers, cellophane, and a wide array of chemicals, alongside a diverse portfolio spanning machinery, real estate, retail, hospitality, and financial services.

name: Taiwan Fertilizer Co Ltd
summary: Taiwan Fertilizer Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells inorganic and organic fertilizers, and other chemical products in Taiwan and internationally. The company was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: China Steel Chemical Corp
summary: China Steel Chemical Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production, processing, and sale of coal tar distillation, light oil, coke, and refined carbon material products in Taiwan, China, Australia, and internationally. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Glass Industry Corp
summary: Taiwan Glass Ind. Corp. specializes in the manufacturing, processing, and distribution of flat glass, fiberglass, glass containers, and consumer glassware for construction, automotive, electronics, and packaging applications. Established in 1964, the company is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Run Long Construction Co Ltd
summary: Run Long Construction Co., Ltd. engages in the construction, sale, and leasing of residential and commercial buildings in Taiwan, and is also involved in engineering business. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Fudo Tetra Corp
summary: Established in Tokyo, Japan, in 1947, Fudo Tetra Corporation operates across civil engineering, soil stabilization, and environmental block construction, undertaking infrastructure projects spanning power generation, coastal protection, water supply, transportation, and port facilities.

name: Showa Sangyo Co Ltd
summary: Showa Sangyo Co., Ltd., a diversified Japanese enterprise, specializes in the production, processing, and distribution of food products including cooking oils, wheat flour, starches and sweeteners, and animal feed, along with warehousing and real estate operations. Founded in 1936, it is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: Mitsui DM Sugar Co Ltd
summary: Mitsui DM Sugar Holdings Co.,Ltd., established in Tokyo, Japan in 1947, is a leading Japanese manufacturer and distributor of sugar products and food ingredients, including refined sugars, alternative sweeteners, and food ingredients, alongside property management and warehousing.

name: UT Group Co Ltd
summary: UT Group Co., Ltd. is a Japanese company based in Tokyo that specializes in human resources, providing permanent employee dispatch and outsourcing solutions across manufacturing, design and development, and construction sectors. Established in 1995.

name: China Motor Corp
summary: Based in Taiwan, China Motor Corporation specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of vehicles and their constituent components, including commercial vehicles, sedans, light commercial vehicles, trucks, electric scooters, and bicycles. Established in 1969, headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: EVERGREEN Steel Corp
summary: Evergreen Steel Corporation, headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of various steel products. Established in 1982, the company was originally known as Evergreen Development Corporation before adopting its current name.

name: Digital Arts Inc
summary: Digital Arts Inc. specializes in the creation and distribution of cybersecurity software and hardware solutions, with a presence across Japan, the United States, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region, including web/email security, web filtering, and file security products. Established in 1995, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

name: NS Solutions Corp
summary: NS Solutions Corporation, a Tokyo-based subsidiary of Nippon Steel Corporation, provides a wide array of information technology services to clients in Japan and globally, spanning consultancy, system development, IT outsourcing, and data center/cloud services. Founded in 1980.

summary: Established in 1971 and based in New Taipei City, Taiwan, Pan-International Industrial Corp. delivers electronic manufacturing services (EMS), offering wires and cables, connector systems, printed circuit boards, and plastic injection-molded parts to automotive, communications, and consumer electronics industries.

name: Orient Semiconductor Electronics Ltd
summary: Orient Semiconductor Electronics, Ltd., founded in 1971 and based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, operates globally as a manufacturer and vendor of integrated circuits, semiconductor devices, computer motherboards, and electronic circuit boards through its Semiconductor Business and Electronic Manufacturing Services segments.

name: D-Link Corp
summary: Headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, D-Link Corporation is a global enterprise dedicated to the innovation, development, and commercialization of networking technologies, including Wi-Fi routers, network switches, smart home devices, and network security products. Established in 1986.

name: Taiwan-Asia Semiconductor Corp
summary: Taiwan-Asia Semiconductor Corporation specializes in the development, production, and worldwide distribution of integrated optoelectronic semiconductor solutions, including LED chips, silicon-based sensor chips, and LED-based display and lighting products. Originally named Opto Tech Corporation, established in 1983, headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

name: Chin-Poon Industrial Co Ltd
summary: Established in 1979 and headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, Chin-Poon Industrial Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise specializing in the fabrication and sale of printed circuit boards (PCBs), insulation materials, and other electronic components, alongside punching equipment for PCB production.

name: Silicon Integrated Systems Corp
summary: Silicon Integrated Systems Corp. (SIS), a global integrated circuit design firm established in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, in 1987, specializes in touch sensor and touch panel chips, MEMS microphones, active pen controllers, and custom system-on-chip design services.

name: Via Technologies Inc
summary: VIA Technologies, Inc. specializes in designing and delivering integrated embedded platforms and system solutions for AI, IoT, general computing, autonomous vehicles, smart cities, and data center applications, including in-vehicle dash cameras and driver assistance systems. Established in 1987, headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: FAN Communications Inc
summary: Established in 1999 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, FAN Communications, Inc. is a key player in the Japanese internet advertising sector, operating A8.net affiliate services, CPA/CPC/CPI advertising, SEO, and cashback shopping platforms.

name: C Sun Manufacturing Ltd
summary: C Sun Mfg Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides various processing equipment in Taiwan, China, and internationally, including printed circuit board processing equipment, touch panel and semiconductor processing equipment, and industrial ovens. Founded in 1966, headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: S-Pool Inc
summary: S-Pool, Inc. provides business and human resources solutions in Japan, offering part-time and temporary employment recruitment, staffing, ESG consulting, and business process outsourcing services. Incorporated in 1999, headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

summary: I-Chiun Precision Industry Co., Ltd. specializes in the global design, production, and distribution of high-precision electronic components including optoelectronic lead frames, small motors, SMD LED products, and LCD system components. The company was formerly known as Core Exploration Limited and changed its name to Core Lithium Ltd in November 2018. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Adelaide, Australia.

name: Danakali Limited
summary: Danakali Limited, along with its associated entities, is active in the mineral exploration sector, primarily within Eritrea, East Africa. The company's central focus is the advancement of the Colluli potash project, situated in Eritrea's Danakil Depression region. Originally incorporated in 2001, the firm was formerly known as South Boulder Mines Ltd. before officially adopting the Danakali Limited name in June 2015. Its corporate headquarters are located in Perth, Australia.

name: Enterprise Metals Limited
summary: Enterprise Metals Limited engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Western Australia. The company explores for copper, gold, nickel, zinc, iron ore, lithium, and base metals. Its primary projects include Murchison, Doolgunna, and Fraser Range projects located in Western Australia. Enterprise Metals Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
